summary: PowerCompute, Inc. filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026 disclosing that on November 2, 2026 it entered into a Fourth Amendment to a Secured Promissory Note with Brown Family Enterprises LLC, effective October 31, 2026. The amendment extends the maturity of the Company's $1,250,000 secured loan from December 31, 2026 to December 31, 2027. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine credit-facility maturity extension rather than a special situation; the covenant and collateral terms warrant monitoring for liquidity strain given repeated amendments.
